harnessLifecycleChange: Installed export probes await staging cleanup before beginning archive inspection, preserving the server exclusive-operation contract exposed by the W18 fixture race.
limits: Grounded integer meanings and primitive words are supplied; the engine does not infer numeric meaning from raw audio.
84 parameter combinations per split; four paired conditions and three targets each do not establish natural-language performance.
Selection validation participates in ranking; interactive validation is not a blind scientific test.
Bounded arithmetic/ordering/linker family; other bases, irregular forms, subtraction, fractions and special powers are outside inference.
84 wrong regularizations remain in each split of the withheld-irregular condition; candidate consensus is not calibrated confidence.
Lower-ranked alternatives can differ from leading-candidate predictions; no universal uniqueness claim.
Question search checks unmapped 1-512 and is not an information-gain optimum.
No LLM calls or model-quality comparison in W19 experiments.
Three gated native unit skips; installed native acceptance is independently exercised.
Four high native dependency-chain audit entries remain.
W15/W18 algorithms, configurations and published result archives are unchanged.
No main merge, public installer release or Pages deployment.
